name: cfpb_hmda_modified_lar_2017_to_2018
limitations: The publisher 2017 CSV data dictionary supplies actual case names and declared types. Its character-varying Loan Amount declaration differs from the parallel Markdown dictionary; the CSV is used consistently.
The official 2018 loan-purpose codesheet has a suspect code-31 description, so Loan Purpose is excluded.
Income, owner occupancy, property type, respondent ID, and geographic field correspondences requiring undocumented conversion rules were excluded.
Coded matches identify the documented concept and applicant/co-applicant or numbered slot; expanded 2018 code domains do not imply lossless data conversion.
Loan Amount is the same measure with changed units/disclosure granularity, and requires conversion; no transformation is evaluated.

name: adyen_classic_payment52_to_checkout72
limitations: Only documented top-level scalar PaymentRequest properties are selected. Arrays, objects, polymorphic payment-method details and arbitrary additionalData keys are outside this schema projection.
Fields with known nested counterparts (fundingSource and stored-payment detail identifiers) are excluded rather than mislabeled absent.
Both the deprecated deliveryDate and replacement deliverAt are retained because the official schema explicitly supports the same concept in both.
dateOfBirth has differing publisher-declared formats (date versus date-time) despite an identical YYYY-MM-DD description; preserve the declaration and flag the inconsistency.
nationality is excluded: the target countryCode definition does not independently establish a distinct residence/billing role, so neither a match nor a hard negative is justified from these sources.
